statement: The proportion of SUID cases with previous preterm births is different from the proportion of non-SUID infant deaths with previous preterm births among fatality review cases.
rationale: This design uses a case-case comparison to identify unique factors that differentiate SUID cases from other types of infant deaths within the same period (2008-2019).
prior_art: The closest tested work is C9 in the SUID manuscript, which discusses maternal smoking as a risk factor for SUID. However, this study does not compare unique factors between SUID and other types of infant deaths within the same case series.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causation or incidence rates due to the lack of a denominator source. It also does not account for potential confounding factors like socioeconomic status and environmental exposures.
